projection_caveat: Straight-line projection from one partial recorder session. Zero-rate cells have no date; category slates are not assumed exchangeable across days.

provider_clock_contract.definition: receiver-clock contract plus non-null exchange/provider source timestamps on both the trade and BBO

receiver_clock_contract.definition: distinct tennis leg-day with a retained trade price and two-sided BBO no more than 30 minutes apart; both rows carry receive timestamps and raw frame hashes
